aggregate_findings.reasoning_format_effect: All three forced-reasoning formats yielded identical accuracy because the same deterministic statistical classifier underlies each response. The format change affects surface output but not the underlying inference pipeline.
aggregate_findings.key_finding: RSA-2048 (256B fixed) and ML-KEM-768 (1088B fixed) are perfectly identifiable by size alone — 100% accuracy. DES/3DES vs AES-128/AES-256 vs ChaCha20 are statistically indistinguishable from ciphertext alone: all produce high Shannon entropy (~7.2–8.0), uniform chi-square, and overlapping file sizes. AES-128 and AES-256 are cryptographically indistinguishable. The ~46.4% accuracy represents the theoretical upper bound for pure ciphertext-only classification on this corpus without exploiting implementation-specific artifacts.
